text_en: And these are the words of the book, which Baruch the son of Nerias, the son of Maasias, the son of Sedecias, the son of Sedei, the son of Helcias, wrote in Babylonia .
text_la: Et hæc verba libri quæ scripsit Baruch filius Neriæ, filii Maasiæ, filii Sedeciæ, filii Sedei, filii Helciæ, in Babylonia,
text_pt: E veio a palavra do SENHOR a Jonas, filho de Amitai, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι τοῦ βιβλίου οὓς ἔγραψεν Βαρουχ υἱὸς Νηριου υἱοῦ Μαασαιου υἱοῦ Σεδεκιου υἱοῦ Ασαδιου υἱοῦ Χελκιου ἐν Βαβυλῶνι

text_en: In the fifth year, in the seventh day of the month, at the time that the Chaldeans took Jerusalem , and burnt it with fire.
text_la: in anno quinto, in septimo die mensis, in tempore quo ceperunt Chaldæi Jerusalem, et succenderunt eam igni.
text_pt: Levanta-te, vai à grande cidade de Nínive, e clama contra ela, porque a sua malícia subiu até à minha presença.
text_el: ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῷ πέμπτῳ ἐν ἑβδόμῃ τοῦ μηνὸς ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ᾧ ἔλαβον οἱ Χαλδαῖοι τὴν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἐνέπρησαν αὐτὴν ἐν πυρί

text_en: And Baruch read the words of this book in the hearing of Jechonias the son of Joakim king of Juda , and in the hearing of all the people that came to hear the book.
text_la: Et legit Baruch verba libri hujus ad aures Jechoniæ filii Joakim regis Juda, et ad aures universi populi venientis ad librum,
text_pt: Porém, Jonas se levantou para fugir da presença do Senhor para Társis. E descendo a Jope, achou um navio que ia para Társis; pagou, pois, a sua passagem, e desceu para dentro dele, para ir com eles para Társis, para longe da presença do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέγνω Βαρουχ τοὺς λόγους τοῦ βιβλίου τούτου ἐν ὠσὶν Ιεχονιου υἱοῦ Ιωακιμ βασιλέως Ιουδα καὶ ἐν ὠσὶ παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ τῶν ἐρχομένων πρὸς τὴν βίβλον

text_en: And in the hearing of the nobles, the sons of the kings, and in the hearing of the ancients, and in the hearing of the people, from the least even to the greatest of them that dwelt in Babylonia , by the river Sedi.
text_la: et ad aures potentium, filiorum regum, et ad aures presbyterorum, et ad aures populi, a minimo usque ad maximum eorum, omnium habitantium in Babylonia, ad flumen Sodi.
text_pt: Mas o Senhor mandou ao mar um grande vento, e fez-se no mar uma forte tempestade, e o navio estava a ponto de quebrar-se.
text_el: καὶ ἐν ὠσὶν τῶν δυνατῶν καὶ υἱῶν τῶν βασιλέων καὶ ἐν ὠσὶ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων καὶ ἐν ὠσὶ παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ ἀπὸ μικροῦ ἕως μεγάλου πάντων τῶν κατοικούντων ἐν Βαβυλῶνι ἐπὶ ποταμοῦ Σουδ

text_en: And when they heard it they wept, and fasted , and prayed before the Lord .
text_la: Qui audientes plorabant, et jejunabant, et orabant in conspectu Domini.
text_pt: Então temeram os marinheiros, e clamavam cada um ao seu deus, e lançaram ao mar as cargas, que estavam no navio, para o aliviarem do seu peso; Jonas, porém, desceu ao porão do navio, e, tendo-se deitado, dormia um profundo sono.
text_el: καὶ ἔκλαιον καὶ ἐνήστευον καὶ ηὔχοντο ἐναντίον κυρίου

text_en: And they made a collection of money according to every man's power.
text_la: Et collegerunt pecuniam, secundum quod potuit uniuscujusque manus,
text_pt: E o mestre do navio chegou- se a ele, e disse-lhe: Que tens, dorminhoco? Levanta-te, clama ao teu Deus; talvez assim ele se lembre de nós para que não pereçamos.
text_el: καὶ συνήγαγον ἀργύριον καθὰ ἑκάστου ἠδύνατο ἡ χείρ

text_en: And they sent it to Jerusalem to Joakim the priest , the son of Helcias, the son of Salom, and to the priests , and to all the people, that were found with him in Jerusalem :
text_la: et miserunt in Jerusalem ad Joakim filium Helciæ filii Salom sacerdotem, et ad sacerdotes, et ad omnem populum qui inventi sunt cum eo in Jerusalem:
text_pt: E diziam cada um ao seu companheiro: Vinde, e lancemos sortes, para que saibamos por que causa nos sobreveio este mal. E lançaram sortes, e a sorte caiu sobre Jonas.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλαν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ πρὸς Ιωακιμ υἱὸν Χελκιου υἱοῦ Σαλωμ τὸν ἱερέα καὶ πρὸς τοὺς ἱερεῖς καὶ πρὸς πάντα τὸν λαὸν τοὺς εὑρεθέντας μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: At the time when he received the vessels of the temple of the Lord , which had been taken away out of the temple , to return them into the land of Juda the tenth day of the month Sivan, the silver vessels, which Sedecias the son of Josias king of Juda had made,
text_la: cum acciperet vasa templi Domini, quæ ablata fuerant de templo, revocare in terram Juda, decima die mensis Sivan, vasa argentea quæ fecit Sedecias filius Josiæ rex Juda,
text_pt: Então lhe disseram: Declara-nos tu agora, por causa de quem nos sobreveio este mal. Que ocupação é a tua? Donde vens? Qual é a tua terra? E de que povo és tu?
text_el: ἐν τῷ λαβεῖν αὐτὸν τὰ σκεύη οἴκου κυρίου τὰ ἐξενεχθέντα ἐκ τοῦ ναοῦ ἀποστρέψαι εἰς γῆν Ιουδα τῇ δεκάτῃ τοῦ Σιουαν σκεύη ἀργυρᾶ ἃ ἐποίησεν Σεδεκιας υἱὸς Ιωσια βασιλεὺς Ιουδα

text_en: after that Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon had carried away Jechonias, and the princes, and all the powerful men, and the people of the land from Jerusalem , and brought them bound to Babylon .
text_la: posteaquam cepisset Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis Jechoniam, et principes, et cunctos potentes, et populum terræ, ab Jerusalem, et duxit eos vinctos in Babylonem.
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Eu sou hebreu, e temo ao Senhor, o Deus do céu, que fez o mar e a terra seca.
text_el: μετὰ τὸ ἀποικίσαι Ναβουχοδονοσορ βασιλέα Βαβυλῶνος τὸν Ιεχονιαν καὶ τοὺς ἄρχοντας καὶ τοὺς δεσμώτας καὶ τοὺς δυνατοὺς καὶ τὸν λαὸν τῆς γῆς ἀπὸ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἤγαγεν αὐτὸν εἰς Βαβυλῶνα

text_en: And they said: Behold we have sent you money, buy with it holocausts , and frankincense, and make meat offerings , and offerings for sin at the altar of the Lord our God :
text_la: Et dixerunt : Ecce misimus ad vos pecunias, de quibus emite holocautomata et thus : et facite manna, et offerte pro peccato, ad aram Domini Dei nostri:
text_pt: Então estes homens se enche-ram de grande temor, e disseram-lhe: Por que fizeste tu isto? Pois sabiam os homens que fugia da presença do Senhor, porque ele lho tinha declarado.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν ἰδοὺ ἀπεστείλαμεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἀργύριον καὶ ἀγοράσατε τοῦ ἀργυρίου ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ περὶ ἁμαρτίας καὶ λίβανον καὶ ποιήσατε μαννα καὶ ἀνοίσατε ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον κυρίου θεοῦ ἡμῶν

text_en: And pray for the life of Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon , and for the life of Balthasar his son, that their days may be upon earth as the days of heaven :
text_la: et orate pro vita Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis, et pro vita Baltassar filii ejus, ut sint dies eorum sicut dies cæli super terram:
text_pt: E disseram-lhe: Que te faremos nós, para que o mar se nos acalme? Porque o mar ia se tornando cada vez mais tempestuoso.
text_el: καὶ προσεύξασθε περὶ τῆς ζωῆς Ναβουχοδονοσορ βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος καὶ εἰς ζωὴν Βαλτασαρ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ ἵνα ὦσιν αἱ ἡμέραι αὐτῶν ὡς αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And that the Lord may give us strength, and enlighten our eyes, that we may live under the shadow of Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon , and under the shadow of Balthasar his son, and may serve them many days, and may find favour in their sight.
text_la: et ut det Dominus virtutem nobis, et illuminet oculos nostros, ut vivamus sub umbra Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis, et sub umbra Baltassar filii ejus, et serviamus eis multis diebus, et inveniamus gratiam in conspectu eorum.
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Levantai-me, e lançai-me ao mar, e o mar se vos aquietará; porque eu sei que por minha causa vos sobreveio esta grande tempestade.
text_el: καὶ δώσει κύριος ἰσχὺν ἡμῖν καὶ φωτίσει τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ἡμῶν καὶ ζησόμεθα ὑπὸ τὴν σκιὰν Ναβουχοδονοσορ βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος καὶ ὑπὸ τὴν σκιὰν Βαλτασαρ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ δουλεύσομεν αὐτοῖς ἡμέρας πολλὰς καὶ εὑρήσομεν χάριν ἐναντίον αὐτῶν

text_en: And pray for us to the Lord our God : for we have sinned against the Lord our God , and his wrath is not turned away from us even to this day.
text_la: Et pro nobis ipsis orate ad Dominum Deum nostrum, quia peccavimus Domino Deo nostro, et non est aversus furor ejus a nobis usque in hunc diem.
text_pt: Entretanto, os homens remavam, para fazer voltar o navio à terra, mas não podiam, porquanto o mar se ia embravecendo cada vez mais contra eles.
text_el: καὶ προσεύξασθε περὶ ἡμῶν πρὸς κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν ὅτι ἡμάρτομεν τῷ κυρίῳ θεῷ ἡμῶν καὶ οὐκ ἀπέστρεψεν ὁ θυμὸς κυρίου καὶ ἡ ὀργὴ αὐτοῦ ἀφ' ἡμῶν ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: And read this book, which we have sent to you to be read in the temple of the Lord , on feasts, and proper days.
text_la: Et legite librum istum quem misimus ad vos recitari in templo Domini, in die solemni et in die opportuno:
text_pt: Então clamaram ao Senhor, e disseram: Ah, Senhor! Nós te rogamos, que não pereçamos por causa da alma deste homem, e que não ponhas sobre nós o sangue inocente; porque tu, Senhor, fizeste como te aprouve.
text_el: καὶ ἀναγνώσεσθε τὸ βιβλίον τοῦτο ὃ ἀπεστείλαμεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐξαγορεῦσαι ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἑορτῆς καὶ ἐν ἡμέραις καιροῦ

text_en: And you shall say: To the Lord our God belongs justice , but to us confusion of our face: as it has come to pass at this day to all Juda , and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem ,
text_la: et dicetis : Domino Deo nostro justitia, nobis autem confusio faciei nostræ, sicut est dies hæc omni Juda, et habitantibus in Jerusalem :
text_pt: E levantaram a Jonas, e o lançaram ao mar, e cessou o mar da sua fúria.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖτε τῷ κυρίῳ θεῷ ἡμῶν ἡ δικαιοσύνη ἡμῖν δὲ αἰσχύνη τῶν προσώπων ὡς ἡ ἡμέρα αὕτη ἀνθρώπῳ Ιουδα καὶ τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: to our kings, and to our princes, and to our priests , and to our prophets , and to our fathers.
text_la: regibus nostris, et principibus nostris, et sacerdotibus nostris, et prophetis nostris, et patribus nostris.
text_pt: Temeram, pois, estes homens ao Senhor com grande temor; e ofereceram sacrifício ao Senhor, e fizeram votos.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς βασιλεῦσιν ἡμῶν καὶ τοῖς ἄρχουσιν ἡμῶν καὶ τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν ἡμῶν καὶ τοῖς προφήταις ἡμῶν καὶ τοῖς πατράσιν ἡμῶν

text_en: We have sinned before the Lord our God , and have not believed him, nor put our trust in him:
text_la: Peccavimus ante Dominum Deum nostrum, et non credidimus, diffidentes in eum :
text_pt: Preparou, pois, o Senhor um grande peixe, para que tragasse a Jonas; e esteve Jonas três dias e três noites nas entranhas do peixe.
text_el: ὧν ἡμάρτομεν ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: And we were not obedient to him, and we have not hearkened to the voice of the Lord our God , to walk in his commandments which he has given us.
text_la: et non fuimus subjectibiles illi, et non audivimus vocem Domini Dei nostri, ut ambularemus in mandatis ejus, quæ dedit nobis.
text_el: καὶ ἠπειθήσαμεν αὐτῷ καὶ οὐκ ἠκούσαμεν τῆς φωνῆς κυρίου θεοῦ ἡμῶν πορεύεσθαι τοῖς προστάγμασιν κυρίου οἷς ἔδωκεν κατὰ πρόσωπον ἡμῶν

text_en: From the day that he brought our fathers out of the land of Egypt , even to this day, we were disobedient to the Lord our God : and going astray we turned away from hearing his voice.
text_la: A die qua eduxit patres nostros de terra Ægypti, usque ad diem hanc, eramus incredibiles ad Dominum Deum nostrum : et dissipati recessimus, ne audiremus vocem ipsius :
text_el: ἀπὸ τῆς ἡμέρας ἧς ἐξήγαγεν κύριος τοὺς πατέρας ἡμῶν ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης ἤμεθα ἀπειθοῦντες πρὸς κύριον θεὸν ἡμῶν καὶ ἐσχεδιάζομεν πρὸς τὸ μὴ ἀκούειν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And many evils have cleaved to us, and the curses which the Lord foretold by Moses his servant: who brought our fathers out of the land of Egypt , to give us a land flowing with milk and honey, as at this day.
text_la: et adhæserunt nobis multa mala et maledictiones quæ constituit Dominus Moysi servo suo, qui eduxit patres nostros de terra Ægypti, dare nobis terram fluentem lac et mel, sicut hodierna die.
text_el: καὶ ἐκολλήθη εἰς ἡμᾶς τὰ κακὰ καὶ ἡ ἀρά ἣν συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ παιδὶ αὐτοῦ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ ἐξήγαγεν τοὺς πατέρας ἡμῶν ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου δοῦναι ἡμῖν γῆν ῥέουσαν γάλα καὶ μέλι ὡς ἡ ἡμέρα αὕτη

text_en: And we have not hearkened to the voice of the Lord our God according to all the words of the prophets whom he sent to us:
text_la: Et non audivimus vocem Domini Dei nostri, secundum omnia verba prophetarum quos misit ad nos :
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἠκούσαμεν τῆς φωνῆς κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν κατὰ πάντας τοὺς λόγους τῶν προφητῶν ὧν ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς ἡμᾶς

text_en: And we have gone away every man after the inclinations of his own wicked heart, to serve strange gods , and to do evil in the sight of the Lord our God .
text_la: et abivimus unusquisque in sensum cordis nostri maligni, operari diis alienis, facientes mala ante oculos Domini Dei nostri.
text_el: καὶ ᾠχόμεθα ἕκαστος ἐν διανοίᾳ καρδίας αὐτοῦ τῆς πονηρᾶς ἐργάζεσθαι θεοῖς ἑτέροις ποιῆσαι τὰ κακὰ κατ' ὀφθαλμοὺς κυρίου θεοῦ ἡμῶν

text_en: Wherefore the Lord our God has made good his word, that he spoke to us, and to our judges that have judged Israel , and to our kings, and to our princes, and to all Israel and Juda :
text_la: Propter quod statuit Dominus Deus noster verbum suum, quod locutus est ad nos, et ad judices nostros qui judicaverunt Israël, et ad reges nostros, et ad principes nostros, et ad omnem Israël et Juda :
text_pt: E orou Jonas ao SENHOR, seu Deus, das entranhas do peixe.
text_el: καὶ ἔστησεν κύριος τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ ὃν ἐλάλησεν ἐφ' ἡμᾶς καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς δικαστὰς ἡμῶν τοὺς δικάσαντας τὸν Ισραηλ καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς βασιλεῖς ἡμῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἄρχοντας ἡμῶν καὶ ἐπὶ ἄνθρωπον Ισραηλ καὶ Ιουδα

text_en: That the Lord would bring upon us great evils , such as never happened under heaven , as they have come to pass in Jerusalem , according to the things that are written in the law of Moses :
text_la: ut adduceret Dominus super nos mala magna, quæ non sunt facta sub cælo quemadmodum facta sunt in Jerusalem, secundum quæ scripta sunt in lege Moysi,
text_pt: E disse: Na minha angústia clamei ao Senhor, e ele me respondeu; do ventre do inferno gritei, e tu ouviste a minha voz.
text_el: οὐκ ἐποιήθη ὑποκάτω παντὸς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καθὰ ἐποίησεν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ κατὰ τὰ γεγραμμένα ἐν τῷ νόμῳ Μωυσῆ

text_en: That a man should eat the flesh of his own son, and the flesh of his own daughter.
text_la: et manducaret homo carnes filii sui et carnes filiæ suæ.
text_pt: Porque tu me lançaste no profundo, no coração dos mares, e a corrente das águas me cercou; todas as tuas ondas e as tuas vagas têm passado por cima de mim.
text_el: τοῦ φαγεῖν ἡμᾶς ἄνθρωπον σάρκας υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἄνθρωπον σάρκας θυγατρὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he has delivered them up to be under the hand of all the kings that are round about us, to be a reproach, and desolation among all the people, among whom the Lord has scattered us.
text_la: Et dedit eos sub manu regum omnium qui sunt in circuitu nostro, in improperium et in desolationem in omnibus populis in quibus nos dispersit Dominus :
text_pt: E eu disse: Lançado estou de diante dos teus olhos; todavia tornarei a ver o teu santo templo.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοὺς ὑποχειρίους πάσαις ταῖς βασιλείαις ταῖς κύκλῳ ἡμῶν εἰς ὀνειδισμὸν καὶ εἰς ἄβατον ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς λαοῖς τοῖς κύκλῳ οὗ διέσπειρεν αὐτοὺς κύριος ἐκεῖ

text_en: And we are brought under, and are not uppermost: because we have sinned against the Lord our God , by not obeying his voice.
text_la: et facti sumus subtus, et non supra, quia peccavimus Domino Deo nostro, non obaudiendo voci ipsius.
text_pt: As águas me cercaram até à alma, o abismo me rodeou, e as algas se enrolaram na minha cabeça.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθησαν ὑποκάτω καὶ οὐκ ἐπάνω ὅτι ἡμάρτομεν κυρίῳ θεῷ ἡμῶν πρὸς τὸ μὴ ἀκούειν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ

text_en: To the Lord our God belongs justice : but to us, and to our fathers confusion of face, as at this day.
text_la: Domino Deo nostro justitia, nobis autem et patribus nostris confusio faciei, sicut est dies hæc :
text_pt: Eu desci até aos fundamentos dos montes; a terra me encerrou para sempre com os seus ferrolhos; mas tu fizeste subir a minha vida da perdição, ó Senhor meu Deus.
text_el: τῷ κυρίῳ θεῷ ἡμῶν ἡ δικαιοσύνη ἡμῖν δὲ καὶ τοῖς πατράσιν ἡμῶν ἡ αἰσχύνη τῶν προσώπων ὡς ἡ ἡμέρα αὕτη

text_en: For the Lord has pronounced against us all these evils that have come upon us:
text_la: quia locutus est Dominus super nos omnia mala hæc quæ venerunt super nos :
text_pt: Quando desfalecia em mim a minha alma, lembrei-me do Senhor; e entrou a ti a minha oração, no teu santo templo.
text_el: ἃ ἐλάλησεν κύριος ἐφ' ἡμᾶς πάντα τὰ κακὰ ταῦτα ἦλθεν ἐφ' ἡμᾶς

text_en: And we have not entreated the face of the Lord our God , that we might return every one of us from our most wicked ways.
text_la: et non sumus deprecati faciem Domini Dei nostri, ut reverteremur unusquisque nostrum a viis nostris pessimis.
text_pt: Os que observam as falsas vaidades deixam a sua misericórdia.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐδεήθημεν τοῦ προσώπου κυρίου τοῦ ἀποστρέψαι ἕκαστον ἀπὸ τῶν νοημάτων τῆς καρδίας αὐτῶν τῆς πονηρᾶς

text_en: And the Lord has watched over us for evil , and has brought it upon us: for the Lord is just in all his works which he has commanded us:
text_la: Et vigilavit Dominus in malis, et adduxit ea super nos : quia justus est Dominus in omnibus operibus suis quæ mandavit nobis,
text_pt: Mas eu te oferecerei sacrifício com a voz do agradecimento; o que votei pagarei. Do Senhor vem a salvação.
text_el: καὶ ἐγρηγόρησεν κύριος ἐπὶ τοῖς κακοῖς καὶ ἐπήγαγε κύριος ἐφ' ἡμᾶς ὅτι δίκαιος ὁ κύριος ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ ἃ ἐνετείλατο ἡμῖν

text_en: And we have not hearkened to his voice to walk in the commandments of the Lord which he has set before us.
text_la: et non audivimus vocem ipsius ut iremus in præceptis Domini, quæ dedit ante faciem nostram.
text_pt: Falou, pois, o Senhor ao peixe, e este vomitou a Jonas na terra seca.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἠκούσαμεν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ πορεύεσθαι τοῖς προστάγμασιν κυρίου οἷς ἔδωκεν κατὰ πρόσωπον ἡμῶν

text_en: And now, O Lord God of Israel , who have brought your people out of the land of Egypt with a strong hand, and with signs , and with wonders, and with your great power, and with a mighty arm, and have made you a name as at this day,
text_la: Et nunc, Domine Deus Israël, qui eduxisti populum tuum de terra Ægypti in manu valida, et in signis, et in prodigiis, et in virtute tua magna, et in brachio excelso, et fecisti tibi nomen sicut est dies iste :
text_el: καὶ νῦν κύριε ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ὃς ἐξήγαγες τὸν λαόν σου ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου ἐν χειρὶ κραταιᾷ καὶ ἐν σημείοις καὶ ἐν τέρασιν καὶ ἐν δυνάμει μεγάλῃ καὶ ἐν βραχίονι ὑψηλῷ καὶ ἐποίησας σεαυτῷ ὄνομα ὡς ἡ ἡμέρα αὕτη

text_en: we have sinned , we have done wickedly , we have acted unjustly , O Lord our God , against all your justices .
text_la: peccavimus, impie egimus, inique gessimus, Domine Deus noster, in omnibus justitiis tuis.
text_el: ἡμάρτομεν ἠσεβήσαμεν ἠδικήσαμεν κύριε ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐπὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς δικαιώμασίν σου

text_en: Let your wrath be turned away from us: for we are left a few among the nations where you have scattered us.
text_la: Avertatur ira tua a nobis, quia derelicti sumus pauci inter gentes ubi dispersisti nos.
text_el: ἀποστραφήτω ὁ θυμός σου ἀφ' ἡμῶν ὅτι κατελείφθημεν ὀλίγοι ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν οὗ διέσπειρας ἡμᾶς ἐκεῖ

text_en: Hear, O Lord , our prayers , and our petitions, and deliver us for your own sake: and grant that we may find favour in the sight of them that have led us away:
text_la: Exaudi, Domine, preces nostras et orationes nostras, et educ nos propter te, et da nobis invenire gratiam ante faciem eorum qui nos abduxerunt :
text_el: εἰσάκουσον κύριε τῆς προσευχῆς ἡμῶν καὶ τῆς δεήσεως ἡμῶν καὶ ἐξελοῦ ἡμᾶς ἕνεκεν σοῦ καὶ δὸς ἡμῖν χάριν κατὰ πρόσωπον τῶν ἀποικισάντων ἡμᾶς

text_en: That all the earth may know that you are the Lord our God , and that your name is called upon Israel , and upon his posterity.
text_la: ut sciat omnis terra quia tu es Dominus Deus noster, et quia nomen tuum invocatum est super Israël, et super genus ipsius.
text_el: ἵνα γνῷ πᾶσα ἡ γῆ ὅτι σὺ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ὅτι τὸ ὄνομά σου ἐπεκλήθη ἐπὶ Ισραηλ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ γένος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Look down upon us, O Lord , from your holy house , and incline your ear, and hear us.
text_la: Respice, Domine, de domo sancta tua in nos, et inclina aurem tuam, et exaudi nos.
text_el: κύριε κάτιδε ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ ἁγίου σου καὶ ἐννόησον εἰς ἡμᾶς κλῖνον κύριε τὸ οὖς σου καὶ ἄκουσον

text_en: Open your eyes, and behold: for the dead that are in hell , whose spirit is taken away from their bowels, shall not give glory and justice to the Lord :
text_la: Aperi oculos tuos et vide : quia non mortui qui sunt in inferno, quorum spiritus acceptus est a visceribus suis, dabunt honorem et justificationem Domino :
text_el: ἄνοιξον κύριε τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς σου καὶ ἰδέ ὅτι οὐχ οἱ τεθνηκότες ἐν τῷ ᾅδῃ ὧν ἐλήμφθη τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τῶν σπλάγχνων αὐτῶν δώσουσιν δόξαν καὶ δικαίωμα τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: But the soul that is sorrowful for the greatness of evil she has done, and goes bowed down, and feeble, and the eyes that fail, and the hungry soul gives glory and justice to you the Lord .
text_la: sed anima quæ tristis est super magnitudine mali, et incedit curva et infirma, et oculi deficientes, et anima esuriens, dat tibi gloriam et justitiam Domino.
text_el: ἀλλὰ ἡ ψυχὴ ἡ λυπουμένη ἐπὶ τὸ μέγεθος ὃ βαδίζει κύπτον καὶ ἀσθενοῦν καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ οἱ ἐκλείποντες καὶ ἡ ψυχὴ ἡ πεινῶσα δώσουσίν σοι δόξαν καὶ δικαιοσύνην κύριε

text_en: For it is not for the justices of our fathers that we pour out our prayers , and beg mercy in your sight, O Lord our God :
text_la: Quia non secundum justitias patrum nostrorum nos fundimus preces et petimus misericordiam ante conspectum tuum, Domine Deus noster :
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ ἐπὶ τὰ δικαιώματα τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν καὶ τῶν βασιλέων ἡμῶν ἡμεῖς καταβάλλομεν τὸν ἔλεον ἡμῶν κατὰ πρόσωπόν σου κύριε ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν

text_en: But because you have sent out your wrath , and your indignation upon us, as you have spoken by the hand of your servants the prophets , saying:
text_la: sed quia misisti iram tuam et furorem tuum super nos, sicut locutus es in manu puerorum tuorum prophetarum, dicens :
text_el: ὅτι ἐνῆκας τὸν θυμόν σου καὶ τὴν ὀργήν σου εἰς ἡμᾶς καθάπερ ἐλάλησας ἐν χειρὶ τῶν παίδων σου τῶν προφητῶν λέγων

text_en: Thus says the Lord : Bow down your shoulder, and your neck, and serve the king of Babylon : and you shall remain in the land which I have given to your fathers.
text_la: Sic dicit Dominus : Inclinate humerum vestrum et cervicem vestram, et opera facite regi Babylonis, et sedebitis in terra quam dedi patribus vestris.
text_el: οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος κλίνατε τὸν ὦμον ὑμῶν καὶ ἐργάσασθε τῷ βασιλεῖ Βαβυλῶνος καὶ καθίσατε ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἣν ἔδωκα τοῖς πατράσιν ὑμῶν

text_en: But if you will not hearken to the voice of the Lord your God , to serve the king of Babylon : I will cause you to depart out of the cities of Juda , and from without Jerusalem .
text_la: Quod si non audieritis vocem Domini Dei vestri, operari regi Babyloniæ, defectionem vestram faciam de civitatibus Juda, et a foris Jerusalem,
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν μὴ ἀκούσητε τῆς φωνῆς κυρίου ἐργάσασθαι τῷ βασιλεῖ Βαβυλῶνος

text_en: And I will take away from you the voice of mirth, and the voice of joy , and the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, and all the land shall be without any footstep of inhabitants.
text_la: et auferam a vobis vocem jucunditatis et vocem gaudii, et vocem sponsi et vocem sponsæ, et erit omnis terra sine vestigio ab inhabitantibus eam.
text_el: ἐκλείψειν ποιήσω ἐκ πόλεων Ιουδα καὶ ἔξωθεν Ιερουσαλημ φωνὴν εὐφροσύνης καὶ φωνὴν χαρμοσύνης φωνὴν νυμφίου καὶ φωνὴν νύμφης καὶ ἔσται πᾶσα ἡ γῆ εἰς ἄβατον ἀπὸ ἐνοικούντων

text_en: And they hearkened not to your voice, to serve the king of Babylon : and you have made good your words, which you spoke by the hands of your servants the prophets , that the bones of our kings, and the bones of our fathers should be removed out of their place:
text_la: Et non audierunt vocem tuam, ut operarentur regi Babylonis : et statuisti verba tua, quæ locutus es in manibus puerorum tuorum prophetarum, ut transferrentur ossa regum nostrorum et ossa patrum nostrorum de loco suo :
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἠκούσαμεν τῆς φωνῆς σου ἐργάσασθαι τῷ βασιλεῖ Βαβυλῶνος καὶ ἔστησας τοὺς λόγους σου οὓς ἐλάλησας ἐν χερσὶν τῶν παίδων σου τῶν προφητῶν τοῦ ἐξενεχθῆναι τὰ ὀστᾶ βασιλέων ἡμῶν καὶ τὰ ὀστᾶ τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν ἐκ τοῦ τόπου αὐτῶν

text_en: And behold they are cast out to the heat of the sun, and to the frost of the night: and they have died in grievous pains, by famine, and by the sword, and in banishment.
text_la: et ecce projecta sunt in calore solis et in gelu noctis, et mortui sunt in doloribus pessimis, in fame et in gladio, et in emissione.
text_el: καὶ ἰδού ἐστιν ἐξερριμμένα τῷ καύματι τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τῷ παγετῷ τῆς νυκτός καὶ ἀπεθάνοσαν ἐν πόνοις πονηροῖς ἐν λιμῷ καὶ ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ καὶ ἐν ἀποστολῇ

text_en: And you have made the temple , in which your name was called upon, as it is at this day, for the iniquity of the house of Israel , and the house of Juda .
text_la: Et posuisti templum in quo invocatum est nomen tuum in ipso sicut hæc dies, propter iniquitatem domus Israël et domus Juda.
text_el: καὶ ἔθηκας τὸν οἶκον οὗ ἐπεκλήθη τὸ ὄνομά σου ἐπ' αὐτῷ ὡς ἡ ἡμέρα αὕτη διὰ πονηρίαν οἴκου Ισραηλ καὶ οἴκου Ιουδα

text_en: And you have dealt with us, O Lord our God , according to all your goodness , and according to all that great mercy of yours:
text_la: Et fecisti in nobis, Domine Deus noster, secundum omnem bonitatem tuam et secundum omnem miserationem tuam illam magnam :
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησας εἰς ἡμᾶς κύριε ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν κατὰ πᾶσαν ἐπιείκειάν σου καὶ κατὰ πάντα οἰκτιρμόν σου τὸν μέγαν

text_en: As you spoke by the hand of your servant Moses , in the day when you commanded him to write your law before the children of Israel ,
text_la: sicut locutus es in manu pueri tui Moysi, in die qua præcepisti ei scribere legem tuam coram filiis Israël,
text_el: καθὰ ἐλάλησας ἐν χειρὶ παιδός σου Μωυσῆ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἐντειλαμένου σου αὐτῷ γράψαι τὸν νόμον σου ἐναντίον υἱῶν Ισραηλ λέγων

text_en: saying: If you will not hear my voice, this great multitude shall be turned into a very small number among the nations , where I will scatter them:
text_la: dicens : Si non audieritis vocem meam, multitudo hæc magna convertetur in minimam inter gentes, quo ego eos dispergam :
text_el: ἐὰν μὴ ἀκούσητε τῆς φωνῆς μου ἦ μὴν ἡ βόμβησις ἡ μεγάλη ἡ πολλὴ αὕτη ἀποστρέψει εἰς μικρὰν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν οὗ διασπερῶ αὐτοὺς ἐκεῖ

text_en: For I know that the people will not hear me, for they are a people of a stiff neck: but they shall turn to their heart in the land of their captivity :
text_la: quia scio quod me non audiet populus : populus est enim dura cervice. Et convertetur ad cor suum in terra captivitatis suæ,
text_el: ὅτι ἔγνων ὅτι οὐ μὴ ἀκούσωσίν μου ὅτι λαὸς σκληροτράχηλός ἐστιν καὶ ἐπιστρέψουσιν ἐπὶ καρδίαν αὐτῶν ἐν γῇ ἀποικισμοῦ αὐτῶν

text_en: And they shall know that I am the Lord their God : and I will give them a heart, and they shall understand: and ears, and they shall hear.
text_la: et scient quia ego sum Dominus Deus eorum : et dabo eis cor, et intelligent; aures, et audient :
text_el: καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεὸς αὐτῶν καὶ δώσω αὐτοῖς καρδίαν καὶ ὦτα ἀκούοντα

text_en: And they shall praise me in the land of their captivity , and shall be mindful of my name .
text_la: et laudabunt me in terra captivitatis suæ, et memores erunt nominis mei,
text_el: καὶ αἰνέσουσίν με ἐν γῇ ἀποικισμοῦ αὐτῶν καὶ μνησθήσονται τοῦ ὀνόματός μου

text_en: And they shall turn away themselves from their stiff neck, and from their wicked deeds : for they shall remember the way of their fathers, that sinned against me.
text_la: et avertent se a dorso suo duro, et a malignitatibus suis : quia reminiscentur viam patrum suorum, qui peccaverunt in me.
text_el: καὶ ἀποστρέψουσιν ἀπὸ τοῦ νώτου αὐτῶν τοῦ σκληροῦ καὶ ἀπὸ πονηρῶν πραγμάτων αὐτῶν ὅτι μνησθήσονται τῆς ὁδοῦ πατέρων αὐτῶν τῶν ἁμαρτόντων ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: And I will bring them back again into the land which I promised with an oath to their fathers, Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob , and they shall be masters thereof: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be diminished.
text_la: Et revocabo illos in terram quam juravi patribus eorum, Abraham, Isaac, et Jacob : et dominabuntur ejus, et multiplicabo eos, et non minorabuntur :
text_el: καὶ ἀποστρέψω αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ὤμοσα τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν τῷ Αβρααμ καὶ τῷ Ισαακ καὶ τῷ Ιακωβ καὶ κυριεύσουσιν αὐτῆς καὶ πληθυνῶ αὐτούς καὶ οὐ μὴ σμικρυνθῶσιν

text_en: And I will make with them another covenant that shall be everlasting, to be their God , and they shall be my people: and I will no more remove my people, the children of Israel , out of the land that I have given them.
text_la: et statuam illis testamentum alterum sempiternum, ut sim illis in Deum, et ipsi erunt mihi in populum : et non movebo amplius populum meum, filios Israël, a terra quam dedi illis.
text_el: καὶ στήσω αὐτοῖς διαθήκην αἰώνιον τοῦ εἶναί με αὐτοῖς εἰς θεὸν καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔσονταί μοι εἰς λαόν καὶ οὐ κινήσω ἔτι τὸν λαόν μου Ισραηλ ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἧς ἔδωκα αὐτοῖς

text_en: And now, O Lord Almighty , the God of Israel , the soul in anguish, and the troubled spirit cries to you:
text_la: Et nunc, Domine omnipotens, Deus Israël, anima in angustiis, et spiritus anxius clamat ad te.
text_pt: E veio a palavra do SENHOR segunda vez a Jonas, dizendo:
text_el: κύριε παντοκράτωρ ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ψυχὴ ἐν στενοῖς καὶ πνεῦμα ἀκηδιῶν κέκραγεν πρὸς σέ

text_en: Hear, O Lord , and have mercy, for you are a merciful God , and have pity on us: for we have sinned before you.
text_la: Audi, Domine, et miserere, quia Deus es misericors : et miserere nostri, quia peccavimus ante te :
text_pt: Levanta-te, e vai à grande cidade de Nínive, e prega contra ela a mensagem que eu te digo.
text_el: ἄκουσον κύριε καὶ ἐλέησον ὅτι ἡμάρτομεν ἐναντίον σου

text_en: For you remain for ever, and shall we perish everlastingly?
text_la: quia tu sedes in sempiternum, et nos, peribimus in ævum?
text_pt: E levantou-se Jonas, e foi a Nínive, segundo a palavra do Senhor. Ora, Nínive era uma cidade muito grande, de três dias de caminho.
text_el: ὅτι σὺ καθήμενος τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ ἡμεῖς ἀπολλύμενοι τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: O Lord Almighty , the God of Israel , hear now the prayer of the dead of Israel , and of their children, that have sinned before you, and have not hearkened to the voice of the Lord their God , wherefore evils have cleaved fast to us.
text_la: Domine omnipotens, Deus Israël, audi nunc orationem mortuorum Israël, et filiorum ipsorum qui peccaverunt ante te, et non audierunt vocem Domini Dei sui, et agglutinata sunt nobis mala.
text_pt: E começou Jonas a entrar pela cidade caminho de um dia, e pregava, dizendo: Ainda quarenta dias, e Nínive será subvertida.
text_el: κύριε παντοκράτωρ ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ἄκουσον δὴ τῆς προσευχῆς τῶν τεθνηκότων Ισραηλ καὶ υἱῶν τῶν ἁμαρτανόντων ἐναντίον σου οἳ οὐκ ἤκουσαν τῆς φωνῆς κυρίου θεοῦ αὐτῶν καὶ ἐκολλήθη ἡμῖν τὰ κακά

text_en: Remember not the iniquities of our fathers, but think upon your hand, and upon your name at this time:
text_la: Noli meminisse iniquitatum patrum nostrorum, sed memento manus tuæ et nominis tui in tempore isto :
text_pt: E os homens de Nínive creram em Deus; e proclamaram um jejum, e vestiram-se de saco, desde o maior até ao menor.
text_el: μὴ μνησθῇς ἀδικιῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν ἀλλὰ μνήσθητι χειρός σου καὶ ὀνόματός σου ἐν τῷ καιρῷ τούτῳ

text_en: For you are the Lord our God , and we will praise you, O Lord :
text_la: quia tu es Dominus Deus noster, et laudabimus te, Domine :
text_pt: Esta palavra chegou também ao rei de Nínive; e ele levantou-se do seu trono, e tirou de si as suas vestes, e cobriu-se de saco, e sentou-se sobre a cinza.
text_el: ὅτι σὺ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν καὶ αἰνέσομέν σε κύριε

text_en: Because for this end you have put your fear in our hearts, to the intent that we should call upon your name , and praise you in our captivity , for we are converted from the iniquity of our fathers, who sinned before you.
text_la: quia propter hoc dedisti timorem tuum in cordibus nostris, et ut invocemus nomen tuum, et laudemus te in captivitate nostra, quia convertimur ab iniquitate patrum nostrorum, qui peccaverunt ante te.
text_pt: E fez uma proclamação que se divulgou em Nínive, pelo decreto do rei e dos seus grandes, dizendo: Nem homens, nem animais, nem bois, nem ovelhas provem coisa alguma, nem se lhes dê alimentos, nem bebam água;
text_el: ὅτι διὰ τοῦτο ἔδωκας τὸν φόβον σου ἐπὶ καρδίαν ἡμῶν τοῦ ἐπικαλεῖσθαι τὸ ὄνομά σου καὶ αἰνέσομέν σε ἐν τῇ ἀποικίᾳ ἡμῶν ὅτι ἀπεστρέψαμεν ἀπὸ καρδίας ἡμῶν πᾶσαν ἀδικίαν πατέρων ἡμῶν τῶν ἡμαρτηκότων ἐναντίον σου

text_en: And behold we are at this day in our captivity , whereby you have scattered us to be a reproach, and a curse , and an offence, according to all the iniquities of our fathers, who departed from you, O Lord our God .
text_la: Et ecce nos in captivitate nostra sumus hodie, qua nos dispersisti in improperium, et in maledictum, et in peccatum, secundum omnes iniquitates patrum nostrorum, qui recesserunt a te, Domine Deus noster.
text_pt: Mas os homens e os animais sejam cobertos de sacos, e clamem fortemente a Deus, e convertam-se, cada um do seu mau caminho, e da violência que há nas suas mãos.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἡμεῖς σήμερον ἐν τῇ ἀποικίᾳ ἡμῶν οὗ διέσπειρας ἡμᾶς ἐκεῖ εἰς ὀνειδισμὸν καὶ εἰς ἀρὰν καὶ εἰς ὄφλησιν κατὰ πάσας τὰς ἀδικίας πατέρων ἡμῶν οἳ ἀπέστησαν ἀπὸ κυρίου θεοῦ ἡμῶν

text_en: Hear, O Israel , the commandments of life: give ear, that you may learn wisdom.
text_la: Audi, Israël, mandata vitæ : auribus percipe, ut scias prudentiam.
text_pt: Quem sabe se se voltará Deus, e se arrependerá, e se apartará do furor da sua ira, de sorte que não pereçamos?
text_el: ἄκουε Ισραηλ ἐντολὰς ζωῆς ἐνωτίσασθε γνῶναι φρόνησιν

text_en: How happens it, O Israel , that you are in your enemies' land?
text_la: Quid est, Israël, quod in terra inimicorum es,
text_pt: E Deus viu as obras deles, como se converteram do seu mau caminho; e Deus se arrependeu do mal que tinha anunciado lhes faria, e não o fez.
text_el: τί ἐστιν Ισραηλ τί ὅτι ἐν γῇ τῶν ἐχθρῶν εἶ ἐπαλαιώθης ἐν γῇ ἀλλοτρίᾳ

text_en: You are grown old in a strange country, you are defiled with the dead: you are counted with them that go down into hell .
text_la: inveterasti in terra aliena, coinquinatus es cum mortuis, deputatus es cum descendentibus in infernum?
text_el: συνεμιάνθης τοῖς νεκροῖς προσελογίσθης μετὰ τῶν εἰς ᾅδου

text_en: You have forsaken the fountain of wisdom:
text_la: Dereliquisti fontem sapientiæ :
text_el: ἐγκατέλιπες τὴν πηγὴν τῆς σοφίας

text_en: For if you had walked in the way of God , you had surely dwelt in peace for ever.
text_la: nam si in via Dei ambulasses, habitasses utique in pace sempiterna.
text_el: τῇ ὁδῷ τοῦ θεοῦ εἰ ἐπορεύθης κατῴκεις ἂν ἐν εἰρήνῃ τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: Learn where is wisdom, where is strength, where is understanding: that you may know also where is length of days and life, where is the light of the eyes, and peace.
text_la: Disce ubi sit prudentia, ubi sit virtus, ubi sit intellectus, ut scias simul ubi sit longiturnitas vitæ et victus, ubi sit lumen oculorum, et pax.
text_el: μάθε ποῦ ἐστιν φρόνησις ποῦ ἐστιν ἰσχύς ποῦ ἐστιν σύνεσις τοῦ γνῶναι ἅμα ποῦ ἐστιν μακροβίωσις καὶ ζωή ποῦ ἐστιν φῶς ὀφθαλμῶν καὶ εἰρήνη

text_en: Who has found out her place? And who has gone in to her treasures?
text_la: Quis invenit locum ejus? et quis intravit in thesauros ejus?
text_el: τίς εὗρεν τὸν τόπον αὐτῆς καὶ τίς εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τοὺς θησαυροὺς αὐτῆς

text_en: Where are the princes of the nations , and they that rule over the beasts that are upon the earth?
text_la: Ubi sunt principes gentium, et qui dominantur super bestias quæ sunt super terram?
text_el: ποῦ εἰσιν οἱ ἄρχοντες τῶν ἐθνῶν καὶ οἱ κυριεύοντες τῶν θηρίων τῶν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: That take their diversion with the birds of the air.
text_la: qui in avibus cæli ludunt,
text_el: οἱ ἐν τοῖς ὀρνέοις τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐμπαίζοντες καὶ τὸ ἀργύριον θησαυρίζοντες καὶ τὸ χρυσίον ᾧ ἐπεποίθεισαν ἄνθρωποι καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν τέλος τῆς κτήσεως αὐτῶν

text_en: That hoard up silver and gold , wherein men trust, and there is no end of their getting? Who work in silver and are solicitous, and their works are unsearchable.
text_la: qui argentum thesaurizant, et aurum, in quo confidunt homines, et non est finis acquisitionis eorum? qui argentum fabricant, et solliciti sunt, nec est inventio operum illorum?
text_el: οἱ τὸ ἀργύριον τεκταίνοντες καὶ μεριμνῶντες καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐξεύρεσις τῶν ἔργων αὐτῶν

text_en: They are cut off, and have gone down to hell , and others are risen up in their place.
text_la: Exterminati sunt, et ad inferos descenderunt, et alii loco eorum surrexerunt.
text_el: ἠφανίσθησαν καὶ εἰς ᾅδου κατέβησαν καὶ ἄλλοι ἀντανέστησαν ἀντ' αὐτῶν

text_en: Young men have seen the light, and dwelt upon the earth: but the way of knowledge they have not known ,
text_la: Juvenes viderunt lumen, et habitaverunt super terram, viam autem disciplinæ ignoraverunt,
text_el: νεώτεροι εἶδον φῶς καὶ κατῴκησαν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ὁδὸν δὲ ἐπιστήμης οὐκ ἔγνωσαν

text_en: nor have they understood the paths thereof, neither have their children received it, it is far from their face.
text_la: neque intellexerunt semitas ejus, neque filii eorum susceperunt eam : a facie ipsorum longe facta est;
text_el: οὐδὲ συνῆκαν τρίβους αὐτῆς οὐδὲ ἀντελάβοντο αὐτῆς οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τῆς ὁδοῦ αὐτῶν πόρρω ἐγενήθησαν

text_en: It has not been heard of in the land of Chanaan , neither has it been seen in Theman.
text_la: non est audita in terra Chanaan, neque visa est in Theman.
text_el: οὐδὲ ἠκούσθη ἐν Χανααν οὐδὲ ὤφθη ἐν Θαιμαν

text_en: The children of Agar also, that search after the wisdom that is of the earth, the merchants of Merrha, and of Theman, and the tellers of fables, and searchers of prudence and understanding: but the way of wisdom they have not known , neither have they remembered her paths.
text_la: Filii quoque Agar, qui exquirunt prudentiam quæ de terra est, negotiatores Merrhæ et Theman, et fabulatores, et exquisitores prudentiæ et intelligentiæ : viam autem sapientiæ nescierunt, neque commemorati sunt semitas ejus.
text_el: οὔτε υἱοὶ Αγαρ οἱ ἐκζητοῦντες τὴν σύνεσιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς οἱ ἔμποροι τῆς Μερραν καὶ Θαιμαν οἱ μυθολόγοι καὶ οἱ ἐκζητηταὶ τῆς συνέσεως ὁδὸν τῆς σοφίας οὐκ ἔγνωσαν οὐδὲ ἐμνήσθησαν τὰς τρίβους αὐτῆς

text_en: O Israel , how great is the house of God , and how vast is the place of his possession!
text_la: O Israël, quam magna est domus Dei, et ingens locus possessionis ejus!
text_el: ὦ Ισραηλ ὡς μέγας ὁ οἶκος τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἐπιμήκης ὁ τόπος τῆς κτήσεως αὐτοῦ

text_en: It is great, and has no end: it is high and immense.
text_la: magnus est, et non habet finem : excelsus, et immensus.
text_el: μέγας καὶ οὐκ ἔχει τελευτήν ὑψηλὸς καὶ ἀμέτρητος

text_en: There were the giants, those renowned men that were from the beginning, of great stature, expert in war .
text_la: Ibi fuerunt gigantes nominati illi, qui ab initio fuerunt, statura magna, scientes bellum.
text_el: ἐκεῖ ἐγεννήθησαν οἱ γίγαντες οἱ ὀνομαστοὶ οἱ ἀπ' ἀρχῆς γενόμενοι εὐμεγέθεις ἐπιστάμενοι πόλεμον

text_en: The Lord chose not them, neither did they find the way of knowledge : therefore did they perish.
text_la: Non hos elegit Dominus, neque viam disciplinæ invenerunt : propterea perierunt,
text_el: οὐ τούτους ἐξελέξατο ὁ θεὸς οὐδὲ ὁδὸν ἐπιστήμης ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς

text_en: And because they had not wisdom, they perished through their folly.
text_la: et quoniam non habuerunt sapientiam, interierunt propter suam insipientiam.
text_el: καὶ ἀπώλοντο παρὰ τὸ μὴ ἔχειν φρόνησιν ἀπώλοντο διὰ τὴν ἀβουλίαν αὐτῶν

text_en: Who has gone up into heaven , and taken her, and brought her down from the clouds?
text_la: Quis ascendit in cælum, et accepit eam, et eduxit eam de nubibus?
text_el: τίς ἀνέβη εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ ἔλαβεν αὐτὴν καὶ κατεβίβασεν αὐτὴν ἐκ τῶν νεφελῶν

text_en: Who has passed over the sea, and found her, and brought her preferably to chosen gold?
text_la: Quis transfretavit mare, et invenit illam, et attulit illam super aurum electum?
text_el: τίς διέβη πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ εὗρεν αὐτὴν καὶ οἴσει αὐτὴν χρυσίου ἐκλεκτοῦ

text_en: There is none that is able to know her ways, nor that can search out her paths:
text_la: Non est qui possit scire vias ejus, neque qui exquirat semitas ejus :
text_el: οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ γινώσκων τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτῆς οὐδὲ ὁ ἐνθυμούμενος τὴν τρίβον αὐτῆς

text_en: But he that knows all things, knows her, and has found her out with his understanding: he that prepared the earth for evermore, and filled it with cattle and fourfooted beasts:
text_la: sed qui scit universa novit eam, et adinvenit eam prudentia sua qui præparavit terram in æterno tempore : et replevit eam pecudibus et quadrupedibus
text_el: ἀλλὰ ὁ εἰδὼς τὰ πάντα γινώσκει αὐτήν ἐξεῦρεν αὐτὴν τῇ συνέσει αὐτοῦ ὁ κατασκευάσας τὴν γῆν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα χρόνον ἐνέπλησεν αὐτὴν κτηνῶν τετραπόδων

text_en: He that sends forth the light, and it goes: and has called it, and it obeys him with trembling .
text_la: qui emittit lumen, et vadit, et vocavit illud, et obedit illi in tremore.
text_el: ὁ ἀποστέλλων τὸ φῶς καὶ πορεύεται ἐκάλεσεν αὐτό καὶ ὑπήκουσεν αὐτῷ τρόμῳ

text_en: And the stars have given light in their watches, and rejoiced:
text_la: Stellæ autem dederunt lumen in custodiis suis, et lætatæ sunt :
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἀστέρες ἔλαμψαν ἐν ταῖς φυλακαῖς αὐτῶν καὶ εὐφράνθησαν

text_en: They were called, and they said: Here we are: and with cheerfulness they have shined forth to him that made them.
text_la: vocatæ sunt, et dixerunt : Adsumus, et luxerunt ei cum jucunditate, qui fecit illas.
text_el: ἐκάλεσεν αὐτοὺς καὶ εἶπον πάρεσμεν ἔλαμψαν μετ' εὐφροσύνης τῷ ποιήσαντι αὐτούς

text_en: This is our God , and there shall no other be accounted of in comparison of him.
text_la: Hic est Deus noster, et non æstimabitur alius adversus eum.
text_el: οὗτος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν οὐ λογισθήσεται ἕτερος πρὸς αὐτόν

text_en: He found out all the way of knowledge , and gave it to Jacob his servant, and to Israel his beloved.
text_la: Hic adinvenit omnem viam disciplinæ, et tradidit illam Jacob puero suo, et Israël dilecto suo.
text_el: ἐξεῦρεν πᾶσαν ὁδὸν ἐπιστήμης καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὴν Ιακωβ τῷ παιδὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ Ισραηλ τῷ ἠγαπημένῳ ὑπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: Afterwards he was seen upon earth, and conversed with men .
text_la: Post hæc in terris visus est, et cum hominibus conversatus est.
text_el: μετὰ τοῦτο ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ὤφθη καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἀνθρώποις συνανεστράφη

text_en: This is the book of the commandments of God , and the law , that is for ever: all they that keep it, shall come to life: but they that have forsaken it, to death.
text_la: Hic liber mandatorum Dei, et lex quæ est in æternum : omnes qui tenent eam pervenient ad vitam : qui autem dereliquerunt eam, in mortem.
text_pt: Mas isso desagradou extremamente a Jonas, e ele ficou irado.
text_el: αὕτη ἡ βίβλος τῶν προσταγμάτων τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ὁ νόμος ὁ ὑπάρχων εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα πάντες οἱ κρατοῦντες αὐτῆς εἰς ζωήν οἱ δὲ καταλείποντες αὐτὴν ἀποθανοῦνται

text_en: Return, O Jacob , and take hold of it, walk in the way by its brightness, in the presence of the light thereof.
text_la: Convertere, Jacob, et apprehende eam : ambula per viam ad splendorem ejus contra lumen ejus.
text_pt: E orou ao Senhor, e disse: Ah! Senhor! Não foi esta minha palavra, estando ainda na minha terra? Por isso é que me preveni, fugindo para Társis, pois sabia que és Deus compassivo e misericordioso, longânimo e grande em benignidade, e que te arrependes do mal.
text_el: ἐπιστρέφου Ιακωβ καὶ ἐπιλαβοῦ αὐτῆς διόδευσον πρὸς τὴν λάμψιν κατέναντι τοῦ φωτὸς αὐτῆς

text_en: Give not your honour to another, nor your dignity to a strange nation.
text_la: Ne tradas alteri gloriam tuam, et dignitatem tuam genti alienæ.
text_pt: Peço-te, pois, ó Senhor, tira-me a vida, porque melhor me é morrer do que viver.
text_el: μὴ δῷς ἑτέρῳ τὴν δόξαν σου καὶ τὰ συμφέροντά σοι ἔθνει ἀλλοτρίῳ

text_en: We are happy , O Israel : because the things that are pleasing to God , are made known to us.
text_la: Beati sumus, Israël, quia quæ Deo placent manifesta sunt nobis.
text_pt: E disse o Senhor: Fazes bem que assim te ires?
text_el: μακάριοί ἐσμεν Ισραηλ ὅτι τὰ ἀρεστὰ τῷ θεῷ ἡμῖν γνωστά ἐστιν

text_en: Be of good comfort, O people of God, the memorial of Israel :
text_la: Animæquior esto, populus Dei, memorabilis Israël :
text_pt: Então Jonas saiu da cidade, e sentou-se ao oriente dela; e ali fez uma cabana, e sentou-se debaixo dela, à sombra, até ver o que aconteceria à cidade.
text_el: θαρσεῖτε λαός μου μνημόσυνον Ισραηλ

text_en: You have been sold to the Gentiles , not for your destruction: but because you provoked God to wrath , you are delivered to your adversaries.
text_la: venundati estis gentibus non in perditionem : sed propter quod in ira ad iracundiam provocastis Deum, traditi estis adversariis.
text_pt: E fez o Senhor Deus nascer uma aboboreira, e ela subiu por cima de Jonas, para que fizesse sombra sobre a sua cabeça, a fim de o livrar do seu enfado; e Jonas se alegrou em extremo por causa da aboboreira.
text_el: ἐπράθητε τοῖς ἔθνεσιν οὐκ εἰς ἀπώλειαν διὰ δὲ τὸ παροργίσαι ὑμᾶς τὸν θεὸν παρεδόθητε τοῖς ὑπεναντίοις

text_en: For you have provoked him who made you, the eternal God , offering sacrifice to devils , and not to God .
text_la: Exacerbastis enim eum qui fecit vos, Deum æternum, immolantes dæmoniis, et non Deo.
text_pt: Mas Deus enviou um verme, no dia seguinte ao subir da alva, o qual feriu a aboboreira, e esta se secou.
text_el: παρωξύνατε γὰρ τὸν ποιήσαντα ὑμᾶς θύσαντες δαιμονίοις καὶ οὐ θεῷ

text_en: For you have forgotten God , who brought you up, and you have grieved Jerusalem that nursed you.
text_la: Obliti enim estis Deum qui nutrivit vos, et contristastis nutricem vestram Jerusalem.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, aparecendo o sol, Deus mandou um vento calmoso oriental, e o sol feriu a cabeça de Jonas; e ele desmaiou, e desejou com toda a sua alma morrer, dizendo: Melhor me é morrer do que viver.
text_el: ἐπελάθεσθε δὲ τὸν τροφεύσαντα ὑμᾶς θεὸν αἰώνιον ἐλυπήσατε δὲ καὶ τὴν ἐκθρέψασαν ὑμᾶς Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: For she saw the wrath of God coming upon you, and she said: Give ear, all you that dwell near Sion , for God has brought upon me great mourning:
text_la: Vidit enim iracundiam a Deo venientem vobis, et dixit : Audite, confines Sion : adduxit enim mihi Deus luctum magnum.
text_pt: Então disse Deus a Jonas: Fazes bem que assim te ires por causa da aboboreira? E ele disse: Faço bem que me revolte até à morte.
text_el: εἶδεν γὰρ τὴν ἐπελθοῦσαν ὑμῖν ὀργὴν παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ εἶπεν ἀκούσατε αἱ πάροικοι Σιων ἐπήγαγέν μοι ὁ θεὸς πένθος μέγα

text_en: For I have seen the captivity of my people, of my sons, and my daughters, which the Eternal has brought upon them.
text_la: Vidi enim captivitatem populi mei, filiorum meorum et filiarum, quam superduxit illis Æternus.
text_pt: E disse o Senhor: Tiveste tu compaixão da aboboreira, na qual não trabalhaste, nem a fizeste crescer, que numa noite nasceu, e numa noite pereceu;
text_el: εἶδον γὰρ τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν τῶν υἱῶν μου καὶ τῶν θυγατέρων ἣν ἐπήγαγεν αὐτοῖς ὁ αἰώνιος

text_en: For I nourished them with joy : but I sent them away with weeping and mourning.
text_la: Nutrivi enim illos cum jucunditate; dimisi autem illos cum fletu et luctu.
text_pt: E não hei de eu ter compaixão da grande cidade de Nínive, em que estão mais de cento e vinte mil homens que não sabem discernir entre a sua mão direita e a sua mão esquerda, e também muitos animais?
text_el: ἔθρεψα γὰρ αὐτοὺς μετ' εὐφροσύνης ἐξαπέστειλα δὲ μετὰ κλαυθμοῦ καὶ πένθους

text_en: Let no man rejoice over me, a widow , and desolate: I am forsaken of many for the sins of my children, because they departed from the law of God .
text_la: Nemo gaudeat super me viduam et desolatam : a multis derelicta sum propter peccata filiorum meorum, quia declinaverunt a lege Dei.
text_el: μηδεὶς ἐπιχαιρέτω μοι τῇ χήρᾳ καὶ καταλειφθείσῃ ὑπὸ πολλῶν ἠρημώθην διὰ τὰς ἁμαρτίας τῶν τέκνων μου διότι ἐξέκλιναν ἐκ νόμου θεοῦ

text_en: And they have not known his justices, nor walked by the ways of God's commandments , neither have they entered by the paths of his truth and justice .
text_la: Justitias autem ipsius nescierunt, nec ambulaverunt per vias mandatorum Dei, neque per semitas veritatis ejus cum justitia ingressi sunt.
text_el: δικαιώματα δὲ αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν οὐδὲ ἐπορεύθησαν ὁδοῖς ἐντολῶν θεοῦ οὐδὲ τρίβους παιδείας ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ αὐτοῦ ἐπέβησαν

text_en: Let them that dwell about Sion come, and remember the captivity of my sons and daughters, which the Eternal has brought upon them.
text_la: Veniant confines Sion, et memorentur captivitatem filiorum et filiarum mearum, quam superduxit illis Æternus.
text_el: ἐλθάτωσαν αἱ πάροικοι Σιων καὶ μνήσθητε τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν τῶν υἱῶν μου καὶ θυγατέρων ἣν ἐπήγαγεν αὐτοῖς ὁ αἰώνιος

text_en: For he has brought a nation upon them from afar, a wicked nation, and of a strange tongue:
text_la: Adduxit enim super illos gentem de longinquo, gentem improbam, et alterius linguæ,
text_el: ἐπήγαγεν γὰρ ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἔθνος μακρόθεν ἔθνος ἀναιδὲς καὶ ἀλλόγλωσσον οἳ οὐκ ᾐσχύνθησαν πρεσβύτην οὐδὲ παιδίον ἠλέησαν

text_en: Who have neither reverenced the ancient, nor pitied children, and have carried away the beloved of the widow , and have left me all alone without children.
text_la: qui non sunt reveriti senem, neque puerorum miserti sunt, et abduxerunt dilectos viduæ, et a filiis unicam desolaverunt.
text_el: καὶ ἀπήγαγον τοὺς ἀγαπητοὺς τῆς χήρας καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν θυγατέρων τὴν μόνην ἠρήμωσαν

text_en: But as for me, what help can I give you?
text_la: Ego autem, quid possum adjuvare vos?
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ τί δυνατὴ βοηθῆσαι ὑμῖν

text_en: But he that has brought the evils upon you, he will deliver you out of the hands of your enemies.
text_la: qui enim adduxit super vos mala, ipse vos eripiet de manibus inimicorum vestrorum.
text_el: ὁ γὰρ ἐπαγαγὼν τὰ κακὰ ὑμῖν ἐξελεῖται ὑμᾶς ἐκ χειρὸς ἐχθρῶν ὑμῶν

text_en: Go your way, my children, go your way: for I am left alone.
text_la: Ambulate, filii, ambulate : ego enim derelicta sum sola.
text_el: βαδίζετε τέκνα βαδίζετε ἐγὼ γὰρ κατελείφθην ἔρημος

text_en: I have put off the robe of peace, and have put upon me the sackcloth of supplication, and I will cry to the most High in my days.
text_la: Exui me stola pacis, indui autem me sacco obsecrationis, et clamabo ad Altissimum in diebus meis.
text_el: ἐξεδυσάμην τὴν στολὴν τῆς εἰρήνης ἐνεδυσάμην δὲ σάκκον τῆς δεήσεώς μου κεκράξομαι πρὸς τὸν αἰώνιον ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις μου

text_en: Be of good comfort, my children, cry to the Lord , and he will deliver you out of the hand of the princes your enemies.
text_la: Animæquiores estote, filii; clamate ad Dominum, et eripiet vos de manu principum inimicorum.
text_el: θαρσεῖτε τέκνα βοήσατε πρὸς τὸν θεόν καὶ ἐξελεῖται ὑμᾶς ἐκ δυναστείας ἐκ χειρὸς ἐχθρῶν

text_en: For my hope is in the Eternal that he will save you: and joy has come upon me from the Holy One , because of the mercy which shall come to you from our everlasting Saviour .
text_la: Ego enim speravi in æternum salutem vestram, et venit mihi gaudium a Sancto, super misericordia quæ veniet vobis ab æterno salutari nostro.
text_el: ἐγὼ γὰρ ἤλπισα ἐπὶ τῷ αἰωνίῳ τὴν σωτηρίαν ὑμῶν καὶ ἦλθέν μοι χαρὰ παρὰ τοῦ ἁγίου ἐπὶ τῇ ἐλεημοσύνῃ ἣ ἥξει ὑμῖν ἐν τάχει παρὰ τοῦ αἰωνίου σωτῆρος ὑμῶν

text_en: For I sent you forth with mourning and weeping: but the Lord will bring you back to me with joy and gladness for ever.
text_la: Emisi enim vos cum luctu et ploratu : reducet autem vos mihi Dominus cum gaudio et jucunditate in sempiternum.
text_el: ἐξέπεμψα γὰρ ὑμᾶς μετὰ πένθους καὶ κλαυθμοῦ ἀποδώσει δέ μοι ὁ θεὸς ὑμᾶς μετὰ χαρμοσύνης καὶ εὐφροσύνης εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: For as the neighbours of Sion have now seen your captivity from God : so shall they also shortly see your salvation from God , which shall come upon you with great honour , and everlasting glory .
text_la: Sicut enim viderunt vicinæ Sion captivitatem vestram a Deo, sic videbunt et in celeritate salutem vestram a Deo, quæ superveniet vobis cum honore magno et splendore æterno.
text_el: ὥσπερ γὰρ νῦν ἑωράκασιν αἱ πάροικοι Σιων τὴν ὑμετέραν αἰχμαλωσίαν οὕτως ὄψονται ἐν τάχει τὴν παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν σωτηρίαν ἣ ἐπελεύσεται ὑμῖν μετὰ δόξης μεγάλης καὶ λαμπρότητος τοῦ αἰωνίου

text_en: My children, suffer patiently the wrath that has come upon you: for your enemy has persecuted you, but you shall quickly see his destruction: and you shall get up upon his neck.
text_la: Filii, patienter sustinete iram quæ supervenit vobis : persecutus est enim te inimicus tuus : sed cito videbis perditionem ipsius, et super cervices ipsius ascendes.
text_el: τέκνα μακροθυμήσατε τὴν παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐπελθοῦσαν ὑμῖν ὀργήν κατεδίωξέν σε ὁ ἐχθρός σου καὶ ὄψει αὐτοῦ τὴν ἀπώλειαν ἐν τάχει καὶ ἐπὶ τραχήλους αὐτῶν ἐπιβήσῃ

text_en: My delicate ones have walked rough ways, for they were taken away as a flock made a prey by the enemies.
text_la: Delicati mei ambulaverunt vias asperas : ducti sunt enim ut grex direptus ab inimicis.
text_el: οἱ τρυφεροί μου ἐπορεύθησαν ὁδοὺς τραχείας ἤρθησαν ὡς ποίμνιον ἡρπασμένον ὑπὸ ἐχθρῶν

text_en: Be of good comfort, my children, and cry to the Lord : for you shall be remembered by him that has led you away.
text_la: Animæquiores estote, filii, et proclamate ad Dominum : erit enim memoria vestra ab eo qui duxit vos.
text_el: θαρσήσατε τέκνα καὶ βοήσατε πρὸς τὸν θεόν ἔσται γὰρ ὑμῶν ὑπὸ τοῦ ἐπάγοντος μνεία

text_en: For as it was your mind to go astray from God ; so when you return again you shall seek him ten times as much.
text_la: Sicut enim fuit sensus vester ut erraretis a Deo, decies tantum iterum convertentes requiretis eum :
text_el: ὥσπερ γὰρ ἐγένετο ἡ διάνοια ὑμῶν εἰς τὸ πλανηθῆναι ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ δεκαπλασιάσατε ἐπιστραφέντες ζητῆσαι αὐτόν

text_en: For he that has brought evils upon you, shall bring you everlasting joy again with your salvation .
text_la: qui enim induxit vobis mala, ipse rursum adducet vobis sempiternam jucunditatem cum salute vestra.
text_el: ὁ γὰρ ἐπαγαγὼν ὑμῖν τὰ κακὰ ἐπάξει ὑμῖν τὴν αἰώνιον εὐφροσύνην μετὰ τῆς σωτηρίας ὑμῶν

text_en: Be of good heart, O Jerusalem : for he exhorts you, that named you.
text_la: Animæquior esto, Jerusalem : exhortatur enim te, qui te nominavit.
text_el: θάρσει Ιερουσαλημ παρακαλέσει σε ὁ ὀνομάσας σε

text_en: The wicked that have afflicted you, shall perish: and they that have rejoiced at your ruin, shall be punished.
text_la: Nocentes peribunt, qui te vexaverunt : et qui gratulati sunt in tua ruina, punientur.
text_el: δείλαιοι οἱ σὲ κακώσαντες καὶ ἐπιχαρέντες τῇ σῇ πτώσει

text_en: The cities which your children have served, shall be punished: and she that received your sons.
text_la: Civitates quibus servierunt filii tui, punientur, et quæ accepit filios tuos.
text_el: δείλαιαι αἱ πόλεις αἷς ἐδούλευσαν τὰ τέκνα σου δειλαία ἡ δεξαμένη τοὺς υἱούς σου

text_en: For as she rejoiced at your ruin, and was glad of your fall: so shall she be grieved for her own desolation.
text_la: Sicut enim gavisa est in tua ruina, et lætata est in casu tuo, sic contristabitur in sua desolatione,
text_el: ὥσπερ γὰρ ἐχάρη ἐπὶ τῇ σῇ πτώσει καὶ εὐφράνθη ἐπὶ τῷ πτώματί σου οὕτως λυπηθήσεται ἐπὶ τῇ ἑαυτῆς ἐρημίᾳ

text_en: And the joy of her multitude shall be cut off: and her gladness shall be turned to mourning.
text_la: et amputabitur exsultatio multitudinis ejus, et gaudimonium ejus erit in luctum.
text_el: καὶ περιελῶ αὐτῆς τὸ ἀγαλλίαμα τῆς πολυοχλίας καὶ τὸ ἀγαυρίαμα αὐτῆς ἔσται εἰς πένθος

text_en: For fire shall come upon her from the Eternal , long to endure, and she shall be inhabited by devils for a great time.
text_la: Ignis enim superveniet ei ab Æterno in longiturnis diebus, et habitabitur a dæmoniis in multitudine temporis.
text_el: πῦρ γὰρ ἐπελεύσεται αὐτῇ παρὰ τοῦ αἰωνίου εἰς ἡμέρας μακράς καὶ κατοικηθήσεται ὑπὸ δαιμονίων τὸν πλείονα χρόνον

text_en: Look about you, O Jerusalem , towards the east, and behold the joy that comes to you from God .
text_la: Circumspice, Jerusalem, ad orientem, et vide jucunditatem a Deo tibi venientem.
text_el: περίβλεψαι πρὸς ἀνατολάς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἰδὲ τὴν εὐφροσύνην τὴν παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ σοι ἐρχομένην

text_en: For behold your children come, whom you sent away scattered , they come gathered together from the east even to the west, at the word of the Holy One rejoicing for the honour of God .
text_la: Ecce enim veniunt filii tui, quos dimisisti dispersos : veniunt collecti ab oriente usque ad occidentem, in verbo Sancti, gaudentes in honorem Dei.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἔρχονται οἱ υἱοί σου οὓς ἐξαπέστειλας ἔρχονται συνηγμένοι ἀπ' ἀνατολῶν ἕως δυσμῶν τῷ ῥήματι τοῦ ἁγίου χαίροντες τῇ τοῦ θεοῦ δόξῃ

text_en: Put off, O Jerusalem , the garment of your mourning, and affliction: and put on the beauty, and honour of that everlasting glory which you have from God .
text_la: Exue te, Jerusalem, stola luctus et vexationis tuæ, et indue te decore, et honore ejus, quæ a Deo tibi est, sempiternæ gloriæ.
text_el: ἔκδυσαι Ιερουσαλημ τὴν στολὴν τοῦ πένθους καὶ τῆς κακώσεώς σου καὶ ἔνδυσαι τὴν εὐπρέπειαν τῆς παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ δόξης εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: God will clothe you with the double garment of justice , and will set a crown on your head of everlasting honour .
text_la: Circumdabit te Deus diploide justitiæ, et imponet mitram capiti honoris æterni.
text_el: περιβαλοῦ τὴν διπλοΐδα τῆς παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ δικαιοσύνης ἐπίθου τὴν μίτραν ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλήν σου τῆς δόξης τοῦ αἰωνίου

text_en: For God will show his brightness in you, to every one under heaven .
text_la: Deus enim ostendet splendorem suum in te, omni qui sub cælo est.
text_el: ὁ γὰρ θεὸς δείξει τῇ ὑπ' οὐρανὸν πάσῃ τὴν σὴν λαμπρότητα

text_en: For your name shall be named to you by God for ever: the peace of justice , and honour of piety.
text_la: Nominabitur enim tibi nomen tuum a Deo in sempiternum : pax justitiæ, et honor pietatis.
text_el: κληθήσεται γάρ σου τὸ ὄνομα παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα εἰρήνη δικαιοσύνης καὶ δόξα θεοσεβείας

text_en: Arise, O Jerusalem , and stand on high: and look about towards the east, and behold your children gathered together from the rising to the setting sun, by the word of the Holy One rejoicing in the remembrance of God .
text_la: Exsurge, Jerusalem, et sta in excelso : et circumspice ad orientem, et vide collectos filios tuos ab oriente sole usque ad occidentem, in verbo Sancti, gaudentes Dei memoria.
text_el: ἀνάστηθι Ιερουσαλημ καὶ στῆθι ἐπὶ τοῦ ὑψηλοῦ καὶ περίβλεψαι πρὸς ἀνατολὰς καὶ ἰδέ σου συνηγμένα τὰ τέκνα ἀπὸ ἡλίου δυσμῶν ἕως ἀνατολῶν τῷ ῥήματι τοῦ ἁγίου χαίροντας τῇ τοῦ θεοῦ μνείᾳ

text_en: For they went out from you on foot, led by the enemies: but the Lord will bring them to you exalted with honour as children of the kingdom .
text_la: Exierunt enim abs te pedibus ducti ab inimicis : adducet autem illos Dominus ad te portatos in honore sicut filios regni :
text_el: ἐξῆλθον γὰρ παρὰ σοῦ πεζοὶ ἀγόμενοι ὑπὸ ἐχθρῶν εἰσάγει δὲ αὐτοὺς ὁ θεὸς πρὸς σὲ αἰρομένους μετὰ δόξης ὡς θρόνον βασιλείας

text_en: For God has appointed to bring down every high mountain, and the everlasting rocks, and to fill up the valleys to make them even with the ground: that Israel may walk diligently to the honour of God .
text_la: constituit enim Deus humiliare omnem montem excelsum et rupes perennes, et convalles replere in æqualitatem terræ, ut ambulet Israël diligenter in honorem Dei.
text_el: συνέταξεν γὰρ ὁ θεὸς ταπεινοῦσθαι πᾶν ὄρος ὑψηλὸν καὶ θῖνας ἀενάους καὶ φάραγγας πληροῦσθαι εἰς ὁμαλισμὸν τῆς γῆς ἵνα βαδίσῃ Ισραηλ ἀσφαλῶς τῇ τοῦ θεοῦ δόξῃ

text_en: Moreover the woods, and every sweetsmelling tree have overshadowed Israel by the commandment of God .
text_la: Obumbraverunt autem et silvæ, et omne lignum suavitatis Israël ex mandato Dei.
text_el: ἐσκίασαν δὲ καὶ οἱ δρυμοὶ καὶ πᾶν ξύλον εὐωδίας τῷ Ισραηλ προστάγματι τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: For God will bring Israel with joy in the light of his majesty, with mercy, and justice , that comes from him.
text_la: Adducet enim Deus Israël cum jucunditate in lumine majestatis suæ, cum misericordia et justitia quæ est ex ipso.
text_el: ἡγήσεται γὰρ ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ μετ' εὐφροσύνης τῷ φωτὶ τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ σὺν ἐλεημοσύνῃ καὶ δικαιοσύνῃ τῇ παρ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: For the sins that you have committed before God , you shall be carried away captives into Babylon by Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon .
text_la: Propter peccata quæ peccastis ante Deum, abducemini in Babyloniam captivi a Nabuchodonosor rege Babylonis.
text_el: διὰ τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἃς ἡμαρτήκατε ἐναντίον τοῦ θεοῦ ἀχθήσεσθε εἰς Βαβυλῶνα αἰχμάλωτοι ὑπὸ Ναβουχοδονοσορ βασιλέως τῶν Βαβυλωνίων

text_en: And when you have come into Babylon , you shall be there many years, and for a long time, even to seven generations : and after that I will bring you away from thence with peace.
text_la: Ingressi itaque in Babylonem, eritis ibi annis plurimis, et temporibus longis, usque ad generationes septem : post hoc autem educam vos inde cum pace.
text_el: εἰσελθόντες οὖν εἰς Βαβυλῶνα ἔσεσθε ἐκεῖ ἔτη πλείονα καὶ χρόνον μακρὸν ἕως γενεῶν ἑπτά μετὰ τοῦτο δὲ ἐξάξω ὑμᾶς ἐκεῖθεν μετ' εἰρήνης

text_en: But now, you shall see in Babylon gods of gold, and of silver, and of stone, and of wood borne upon shoulders, causing fear to the Gentiles .
text_la: Nunc autem videbitis in Babylonia deos aureos et argenteos, et lapideos et ligneos, in humeris portari, ostentantes metum gentibus.
text_el: νυνὶ δὲ ὄψεσθε ἐν Βαβυλῶνι θεοὺς ἀργυροῦς καὶ χρυσοῦς καὶ ξυλίνους ἐπ' ὤμοις αἰρομένους δεικνύντας φόβον τοῖς ἔθνεσιν

text_en: Beware therefore that you imitate not the doings of others, and be afraid, and the fear of them should seize upon you.
text_la: Videte ergo ne et vos similes efficiamini factis alienis, et metuatis, et metus vos capiat in ipsis.
text_el: εὐλαβήθητε οὖν μὴ καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀφομοιωθέντες τοῖς ἀλλοφύλοις ἀφομοιωθῆτε καὶ φόβος ὑμᾶς λάβῃ ἐπ' αὐτοῖς

text_en: But when you see the multitude behind, and before, adoring them, say you in your hearts: You ought to be adored , O Lord .
text_la: Visa itaque turba de retro et ab ante, adorantes dicite in cordibus vestris : Te oportet adorari, Domine.
text_el: ἰδόντας ὄχλον ἔμπροσθεν καὶ ὄπισθεν αὐτῶν προσκυνοῦντας αὐτά εἴπατε δὲ τῇ διανοίᾳ σοὶ δεῖ προσκυνεῖν δέσποτα

text_en: For my angel is with you: And I myself will demand an account of your souls .
text_la: Angelus enim meus vobiscum est : ipse autem exquiram animas vestras.
text_el: ὁ γὰρ ἄγγελός μου μεθ' ὑμῶν ἐστιν αὐτός τε ἐκζητῶν τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν

text_en: For their tongue that is polished by the craftsman, and themselves laid over with gold and silver, are false things, and they cannot speak.
text_la: Nam lingua ipsorum polita a fabro; ipsa etiam inaurata et inargentata : falsa sunt, et non possunt loqui.
text_el: γλῶσσα γὰρ αὐτῶν ἐστιν κατεξυσμένη ὑπὸ τέκτονος αὐτά τε περίχρυσα καὶ περιάργυρα ψευδῆ δ' ἐστὶν καὶ οὐ δύνανται λαλεῖν

text_en: And as if it were for a maiden that loves to go gay: so do they take gold and make them up.
text_la: Et sicut virgini amanti ornamenta, ita accepto auro fabricati sunt.
text_el: καὶ ὥσπερ παρθένῳ φιλοκόσμῳ λαμβάνοντες χρυσίον κατασκευάζουσιν στεφάνους ἐπὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς τῶν θεῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: Their gods have golden crowns upon their heads: whereof the priests secretly convey away from them gold, and silver, and bestow it on themselves.
text_la: Coronas certe aureas habent super capita sua dii illorum : unde subtrahunt sacerdotes ab eis aurum et argentum, et erogant illud in semetipsos.
text_el: ἔστι δὲ καὶ ὅτε ὑφαιρούμενοι οἱ ἱερεῖς ἀπὸ τῶν θεῶν αὐτῶν χρυσίον καὶ ἀργύριον εἰς ἑαυτοὺς καταναλώσουσιν δώσουσιν δὲ ἀπ' αὐτῶν καὶ ταῖς ἐπὶ τοῦ τέγους πόρναις

text_en: Yea and they give thereof to prostitutes, and they dress out harlots: and again when they receive it of the harlots, they adorn their gods .
text_la: Dant autem et ex ipso prostitutis, et meretrices ornant : et iterum cum receperint illud a meretricibus, ornant deos suos.
text_el: κοσμοῦσί τε αὐτοὺς ὡς ἀνθρώπους τοῖς ἐνδύμασιν θεοὺς ἀργυροῦς καὶ χρυσοῦς καὶ ξυλίνους οὗτοι δὲ οὐ διασῴζονται ἀπὸ ἰοῦ καὶ βρωμάτων

text_en: And these gods cannot defend themselves from the rust, and the moth.
text_la: Hi autem non liberantur ab ærugine et tinea.
text_el: περιβεβλημένων αὐτῶν ἱματισμὸν πορφυροῦν ἐκμάσσονται τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτῶν διὰ τὸν ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας κονιορτόν ὅς ἐστιν πλείων ἐπ' αὐτοῖς

text_en: But when they have covered them with a purple garment, they wipe their face because of the dust of the house, which is very much among them.
text_la: Opertis autem illis veste purpurea, extergunt faciem ipsorum propter pulverem domus qui est plurimus inter eos.
text_el: καὶ σκῆπτρον ἔχει ὡς ἄνθρωπος κριτὴς χώρας ὃς τὸν εἰς αὐτὸν ἁμαρτάνοντα οὐκ ἀνελεῖ

text_en: This holds a sceptre as a man , as a judge of the country, but cannot put to death one that offends him.
text_la: Sceptrum autem habet ut homo, sicut judex regionis, qui in se peccantem non interficit.
text_el: ἔχει δὲ ἐγχειρίδιον ἐν δεξιᾷ καὶ πέλεκυν ἑαυτὸν δὲ ἐκ πολέμου καὶ λῃστῶν οὐκ ἐξελεῖται

text_en: And this has in his hand a sword, or an axe, but cannot save himself from war , or from robbers, whereby be it known to you, that they are not gods.
text_la: Habet etiam in manu gladium et securim, se autem de bello et a latronibus non liberat. Unde vobis notum sit quia non sunt dii:
text_el: ὅθεν γνώριμοί εἰσιν οὐκ ὄντες θεοί μὴ οὖν φοβηθῆτε αὐτούς

text_en: Therefore fear them not. For as a vessel that a man uses when it is broken becomes useless, even so are their gods :
text_la: non ergo timueritis eos. Sicut enim vas hominis confractum inutile efficitur, tales sunt et dii illorum.
text_el: ὥσπερ γὰρ σκεῦος ἀνθρώπου συντριβὲν ἀχρεῖον γίνεται τοιοῦτοι ὑπάρχουσιν οἱ θεοὶ αὐτῶν καθιδρυμένων αὐτῶν ἐν τοῖς οἴκοις

text_en: When they are placed in the house, their eyes are full of dust by the feet of them that go in.
text_la: Constitutis illis in domo, oculi eorum pleni sunt pulvere a pedibus introëuntium.
text_el: οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτῶν πλήρεις εἰσὶν κονιορτοῦ ἀπὸ τῶν ποδῶν τῶν εἰσπορευομένων

text_en: And as the gates are made sure on every side upon one that has offended the king, or like a dead man carried to the grave, so do the priests secure the doors with bars and locks, lest they be stripped by thieves .
text_la: Et sicut alicui qui regem offendit circumseptæ sunt januæ, aut sicut ad sepulchrum adductum mortuum : ita tutantur sacerdotes ostia clausuris et seris, ne a latronibus expolientur.
text_el: καὶ ὥσπερ τινὶ ἠδικηκότι βασιλέα περιπεφραγμέναι εἰσὶν αἱ αὐλαὶ ὡς ἐπὶ θανάτῳ ἀπηγμένῳ τοὺς οἴκους αὐτῶν ὀχυροῦσιν οἱ ἱερεῖς θυρώμασίν τε καὶ κλείθροις καὶ μοχλοῖς ὅπως ὑπὸ τῶν λῃστῶν μὴ συληθῶσι

text_en: They light candles to them, and in great number, of which they cannot see one: but they are like beams in the house.
text_la: Lucernas accendunt illis, et quidem multas, ex quibus nullam videre possunt : sunt autem sicut trabes in domo.
text_el: λύχνους καίουσιν καὶ πλείους ἢ ἑαυτοῖς ὧν οὐδένα δύνανται ἰδεῖν

text_en: And they say that the creeping things which are of the earth, gnaw their hearts, while they eat them and their garments, and they feel it not.
text_la: Corda vero eorum dicunt elingere serpentes qui de terra sunt, dum comedunt eos, et vestimentum ipsorum, et non sentiunt.
text_el: ἔστιν μὲν ὥσπερ δοκὸς τῶν ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας τὰς δὲ καρδίας αὐτῶν φασιν ἐκλείχεσθαι τῶν ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἑρπετῶν κατεσθόντων αὐτούς τε καὶ τὸν ἱματισμὸν αὐτῶν οὐκ αἰσθάνονται

text_en: Their faces are black with the smoke that is made in the house.
text_la: Nigræ fiunt facies eorum a fumo qui in domo fit.
text_el: μεμελανωμένοι τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τοῦ καπνοῦ τοῦ ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας

text_en: Owls, and swallows, and other birds fly upon their bodies, and upon their heads, and cats in like manner.
text_la: Supra corpus eorum et supra caput eorum volant noctuæ, et hirundines, et aves etiam, similiter et cattæ.
text_el: ἐπὶ τὸ σῶμα αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν ἐφίπτανται νυκτερίδες χελιδόνες καὶ τὰ ὄρνεα ὡσαύτως δὲ καὶ οἱ αἴλουροι

text_en: Whereby you may know that they are no gods. Therefore fear them not.
text_la: Unde sciatis quia non sunt dii : ne ergo timueritis eos.
text_el: ὅθεν γνώσεσθε ὅτι οὔκ εἰσιν θεοί μὴ οὖν φοβεῖσθε αὐτά

text_en: The gold also which they have, is for show, but except a man wipe off the rust, they will not shine: for neither when they were molten, did they feel it.
text_la: Aurum etiam quod habent ad speciem est : nisi aliquis exterserit æruginem, non fulgebunt : neque enim dum conflarentur, sentiebant.
text_el: τὸ γὰρ χρυσίον ὃ περίκεινται εἰς κάλλος ἐὰν μή τις ἐκμάξῃ τὸν ἰόν οὐ μὴ στίλψωσιν οὐδὲ γάρ ὅτε ἐχωνεύοντο ᾐσθάνοντο

text_en: Men buy them at a high price, whereas there is no breath in them.
text_la: Ex omni pretio empta sunt, in quibus spiritus non inest ipsis.
text_el: ἐκ πάσης τιμῆς ἠγορασμένα ἐστίν ἐν οἷς οὐκ ἔστιν πνεῦμα

text_en: And having not the use of feet they are carried upon shoulders, declaring to men how vile they are. Be they confounded also that worship them.
text_la: Sine pedibus, in humeris portantur, ostentantes ignobilitatem suam hominibus : confundantur etiam qui colunt ea.
text_el: ἄνευ ποδῶν ἐπ' ὤμοις φέρονται ἐνδεικνύμενοι τὴν ἑαυτῶν ἀτιμίαν τοῖς ἀνθρώποις αἰσχύνονταί τε καὶ οἱ θεραπεύοντες αὐτὰ διὰ τό μήποτε ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν πέσῃ δι' αὐτῶν ἀνίστασθαι

text_en: Therefore if they fall to the ground, they rise not up again of themselves, nor if a man set them upright, will they stand by themselves, but their gifts shall be set before them, as to the dead.
text_la: Propterea si ceciderint in terram, a semetipsis non consurgunt : neque si quis eum statuerit rectum, per semetipsum stabit : sed sicut mortuis munera eorum illis apponentur.
text_el: μήτε ἐάν τις αὐτὸ ὀρθὸν στήσῃ δι' ἑαυτοῦ κινηθήσεται μήτε ἐὰν κλιθῇ οὐ μὴ ὀρθωθῇ ἀλλ' ὥσπερ νεκροῖς τὰ δῶρα αὐτοῖς παρατίθεται

text_en: The things that are sacrificed to them, their priests sell and abuse: in like manner also their wives take part of them, but give nothing of it either to the sick, or to the poor .
text_la: Hostias illorum vendunt sacerdotes ipsorum, et abutuntur : similiter et mulieres eorum decerpentes, neque infirmo, neque mendicanti, aliquid impertiunt.
text_el: τὰς δὲ θυσίας αὐτῶν ἀποδόμενοι οἱ ἱερεῖς αὐτῶν καταχρῶνται ὡσαύτως δὲ καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες αὐτῶν ἀπ' αὐτῶν ταριχεύουσαι οὔτε πτωχῷ οὔτε ἀδυνάτῳ μεταδιδόασιν τῶν θυσιῶν αὐτῶν ἀποκαθημένη καὶ λεχὼ ἅπτονται

text_en: The childbearing and menstruous women touch their sacrifices : knowing , therefore, by these things that they are not gods, fear them not.
text_la: De sacrificiis eorum fœtæ et menstruatæ contingunt. Sciens itaque ex his quia non sunt dii, ne timeatis eos.
text_el: γνόντες οὖν ἀπὸ τούτων ὅτι οὔκ εἰσιν θεοί μὴ φοβηθῆτε αὐτούς

text_en: For how can they be called gods? Because women set offerings before the gods of silver, and of gold, and of wood:
text_la: Unde enim vocantur dii? quia mulieres apponunt diis argenteis, et aureis, et ligneis:
text_el: πόθεν γὰρ κληθείησαν θεοί ὅτι γυναῖκες παρατιθέασιν θεοῖς ἀργυροῖς καὶ χρυσοῖς καὶ ξυλίνοις

text_en: And priests sit in their temples , having their garments rent, and their heads and beards shaven, and nothing upon their heads.
text_la: et in domibus eorum sacerdotes sedent habentes tunicas scissas, et capita et barbam rasam, quorum capita nuda sunt.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τοῖς οἴκοις αὐτῶν οἱ ἱερεῖς διφρεύουσιν ἔχοντες τοὺς χιτῶνας διερρωγότας καὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς καὶ τοὺς πώγωνας ἐξυρημένους ὧν αἱ κεφαλαὶ ἀκάλυπτοί εἰσιν

text_en: And they roar and cry before their gods, as men do at the feast when one is dead.
text_la: Rugiunt autem clamantes contra deos suos sicut in cœna mortui.
text_el: ὠρύονται δὲ βοῶντες ἐναντίον τῶν θεῶν αὐτῶν ὥσπερ τινὲς ἐν περιδείπνῳ νεκροῦ

text_en: The priests take away their garments, and clothe their wives and their children.
text_la: Vestimenta eorum auferunt sacerdotes, et vestiunt uxores suas et filios suos.
text_el: ἀπὸ τοῦ ἱματισμοῦ αὐτῶν ἀφελόμενοι οἱ ἱερεῖς ἐνδύουσιν τὰς γυναῖκας αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ παιδία

text_en: And whether it be evil that one does unto them, or good , they are not able to recompense it: neither can they set up a king, nor put him down:
text_la: Neque si quid mali patiuntur ab aliquo, neque si quid boni, poterunt retribuere : neque regem constituere possunt, neque auferre.
text_el: οὔτε ἐὰν κακὸν πάθωσιν ὑπό τινος οὔτε ἐὰν ἀγαθόν δυνήσονται ἀνταποδοῦναι οὔτε καταστῆσαι βασιλέα δύνανται οὔτε ἀφελέσθαι

text_en: In like manner they can neither give riches , nor requite evil . If a man make a vow to them, and perform it not: they cannot require it.
text_la: Similiter neque dare divitias possunt, neque malum retribuere. Si quis illis votum voverit et non reddiderit, neque hoc requirunt.
text_el: ὡσαύτως οὔτε πλοῦτον οὔτε χαλκὸν οὐ μὴ δύνωνται διδόναι ἐάν τις αὐτοῖς εὐχὴν εὐξάμενος μὴ ἀποδῷ οὐ μὴ ἐπιζητήσωσιν

text_en: They cannot deliver a man from death, nor save the weak from the mighty.
text_la: Hominem a morte non liberant, neque infirmum a potentiori eripiunt.
text_el: ἐκ θανάτου ἄνθρωπον οὐ μὴ ῥύσωνται οὔτε ἥττονα ἀπὸ ἰσχυροῦ οὐ μὴ ἐξέλωνται

text_en: They cannot restore the blind man to his sight: nor deliver a man from distress.
text_la: Hominem cæcum ad visum non restituunt; de necessitate hominem non liberabunt.
text_el: ἄνθρωπον τυφλὸν εἰς ὅρασιν οὐ μὴ περιστήσωσιν ἐν ἀνάγκῃ ἄνθρωπον ὄντα οὐ μὴ ἐξέλωνται

text_en: They shall not pity the widow , nor do good to the fatherless .
text_la: Viduæ non miserebuntur, neque orphanis benefacient.
text_el: χήραν οὐ μὴ ἐλεήσωσιν οὔτε ὀρφανὸν εὖ ποιήσουσιν

text_en: Their gods, of wood, and of stone, and of gold, and of silver, are like the stones that are hewn out of the mountains: and they that worship them shall be confounded.
text_la: Lapidibus de monte similes sunt dii illorum, lignei, et lapidei, et aurei, et argentei : qui autem colunt ea, confundentur.
text_el: τοῖς ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄρους λίθοις ὡμοιωμένοι εἰσὶν τὰ ξύλινα καὶ τὰ περίχρυσα καὶ τὰ περιάργυρα οἱ δὲ θεραπεύοντες αὐτὰ καταισχυνθήσονται

text_en: How then is it to be supposed, or to be said, that they are gods?
text_la: Quomodo ergo æstimandum est aut dicendum illos esse deos?
text_el: πῶς οὖν νομιστέον ἢ κλητέον αὐτοὺς ὑπάρχειν θεούς

text_en: Even the Chaldeans themselves dishonor them: who when they hear of one dumb that cannot speak, they present him to Bel, entreating him, that he may speak.
text_la: Adhuc enim ipsis Chaldæis non honorantibus ea : qui cum audierint mutum non posse loqui, offerunt illud ad Bel, postulantes ab eo loqui:
text_el: ἔτι δὲ καὶ αὐτῶν τῶν Χαλδαίων ἀτιμαζόντων αὐτά οἵ ὅταν ἴδωσιν ἐνεὸν οὐ δυνάμενον λαλῆσαι προσενεγκάμενοι τὸν Βῆλον ἀξιοῦσιν φωνῆσαι ὡς δυνατοῦ ὄντος αὐτοῦ αἰσθέσθαι

text_en: As though they could be sensible that have no motion themselves: and they, when they shall perceive this, will leave them: for their gods themselves have no sense.
text_la: quasi possint sentire qui non habent motum! Et ipsi, cum intellexerint, relinquent ea : sensum enim non habent ipsi dii illorum.
text_el: καὶ οὐ δύνανται αὐτοὶ νοήσαντες καταλιπεῖν αὐτά αἴσθησιν γὰρ οὐκ ἔχουσιν

text_en: The women also, with cords about them, sit in the ways, burning olive-stones.
text_la: Mulieres autem circumdatæ funibus in viis sedent, succendentes ossa olivarum:
text_el: αἱ δὲ γυναῖκες περιθέμεναι σχοινία ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς ἐγκάθηνται θυμιῶσαι τὰ πίτυρα

text_en: And when any one of them, drawn away by some passenger, lies with him, she upbraids her neighbor, that she was not thought as worthy as herself, nor her cord broken.
text_la: cum autem aliqua ex ipsis, attracta ab aliquo transeunte, dormierit cum eo, proximæ suæ exprobrat quod ea non sit digna habita, sicut ipsa, neque funis ejus diruptus sit.
text_el: ὅταν δέ τις αὐτῶν ἐφελκυσθεῖσα ὑπό τινος τῶν παραπορευομένων κοιμηθῇ τὴν πλησίον ὀνειδίζει ὅτι οὐκ ἠξίωται ὥσπερ καὶ αὐτὴ οὔτε τὸ σχοινίον αὐτῆς διερράγη

text_en: But all things that are done about them, are false : how is it then to be thought, or to be said, that they are gods?
text_la: Omnia autem quæ illi fiunt, falsa sunt : quomodo æstimandum aut dicendum est illos esse deos?
text_el: πάντα τὰ γινόμενα αὐτοῖς ἐστιν ψευδῆ πῶς οὖν νομιστέον ἢ κλητέον ὥστε θεοὺς αὐτοὺς ὑπάρχειν

text_en: And they are made by workmen, and by goldsmiths. They shall be nothing else but what the priests will have them to be.
text_la: A fabris autem et ab aurificibus facta sunt : nihil aliud erunt, nisi id quod volunt esse sacerdotes.
text_el: ὑπὸ τεκτόνων καὶ χρυσοχόων κατεσκευασμένα εἰσίν οὐθὲν ἄλλο μὴ γένωνται ἢ ὃ βούλονται οἱ τεχνῖται αὐτὰ γενέσθαι

text_en: For the artificers themselves that make them, are of no long continuance. Can those things then that are made by them, be gods?
text_la: Artifices etiam ipsi, qui ea faciunt, non sunt multi temporis : numquid ergo possunt ea, quæ fabricata sunt ab ipsis, esse dii?
text_el: αὐτοί τε οἱ κατασκευάζοντες αὐτὰ οὐ μὴ γένωνται πολυχρόνιοι πῶς τε δὴ μέλλει τὰ ὑπ' αὐτῶν κατασκευασθέντα εἶναι θεοί

text_en: But they have left false things and reproach to them that come after.
text_la: Reliquerunt autem falsa et opprobrium postea futuris.
text_el: κατέλιπον γὰρ ψεύδη καὶ ὄνειδος τοῖς ἐπιγινομένοις

text_en: For when war comes upon them, or evils : the priests consult with themselves, where they may hide themselves with them.
text_la: Nam cum supervenerit illis prælium et mala, cogitant sacerdotes apud se ubi se abscondant cum illis.
text_el: ὅταν γὰρ ἐπέλθῃ ἐπ' αὐτὰ πόλεμος καὶ κακά βουλεύονται πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς οἱ ἱερεῖς ποῦ συναποκρυβῶσι μετ' αὐτῶν

text_en: How then can they be thought to be gods, that can neither deliver themselves from war , nor save themselves from evils ?
text_la: Quomodo ergo sentiri debeant quoniam dii sunt, qui nec de bello se liberant, neque de malis se eripiunt?
text_el: πῶς οὖν οὐκ ἔστιν αἰσθέσθαι ὅτι οὔκ εἰσιν θεοί οἳ οὔτε σῴζουσιν ἑαυτοὺς ἐκ πολέμου οὔτε ἐκ κακῶν

text_en: For seeing they are but of wood, and laid over with gold, and with silver, it shall be known hereafter that they are false things, by all nations , and kings: and it shall be manifest that they are no gods, but the work of men's hands, and that there is no work of God in them.
text_la: Nam cum sint lignea, inaurata et inargentata, scietur postea quia falsa sunt ab universis gentibus et regibus : quæ manifesta sunt quia non sunt dii, sed opera manuum hominum, et nullum Dei opus cum illis.
text_el: ὑπάρχοντα γὰρ ξύλινα καὶ περίχρυσα καὶ περιάργυρα γνωσθήσεται μετὰ ταῦτα ὅτι ἐστὶν ψευδῆ τοῖς ἔθνεσι πᾶσι τοῖς τε βασιλεῦσι φανερὸν ἔσται ὅτι οὔκ εἰσι θεοὶ ἀλλὰ ἔργα χειρῶν ἀνθρώπων καὶ οὐδὲν θεοῦ ἔργον ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐστιν

text_en: Whence, therefore, is it known that they are not gods, but the work of men's hands, and no work of God is in them?
text_la: Unde ergo notum est quia non sunt dii, sed opera manuum hominum, et nullum Dei opus in ipsis est.
text_el: τίνι οὖν γνωστέον ἐστὶν ὅτι οὔκ εἰσιν θεοί

text_en: They cannot set up a king over the land, nor give rain to men .
text_la: Regem regioni non suscitant, neque pluviam hominibus dabunt.
text_el: βασιλέα γὰρ χώρας οὐ μὴ ἀναστήσωσιν οὔτε ὑετὸν ἀνθρώποις οὐ μὴ δῶσιν

text_en: They determine no causes, nor deliver countries from oppression: because they can do nothing, and are as daws between heaven and earth.
text_la: Judicium quoque non discernent, neque regiones liberabunt ab injuria, quia nihil possunt, sicut corniculæ inter medium cæli et terræ.
text_el: κρίσιν τε οὐ μὴ διακρίνωσιν αὐτῶν οὐδὲ μὴ ῥύσωνται ἀδικούμενον ἀδύνατοι ὄντες ὥσπερ γὰρ κορῶναι ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: For when fire shall fall upon the house of these gods of wood, and of silver, and of gold, their priests indeed will flee away, and be saved: but they themselves shall be burnt in the midst like beams.
text_la: Etenim cum inciderit ignis in domum deorum ligneorum, argenteorum et aureorum, sacerdotes quidem ipsorum fugient, et liberabuntur : ipsi vero sicut trabes in medio comburentur.
text_el: καὶ γὰρ ὅταν ἐμπέσῃ εἰς οἰκίαν θεῶν ξυλίνων ἢ περιχρύσων ἢ περιαργύρων πῦρ οἱ μὲν ἱερεῖς αὐτῶν φεύξονται καὶ διασωθήσονται αὐτοὶ δὲ ὥσπερ δοκοὶ μέσοι κατακαυθήσονται
